read_conflict_range is the set of logical keys used for conflict detection; a later write in that range prevents commit, and conflicting_keys identifies intersections with another transaction's write conflict range.
TiKV shards continuous key ranges into Regions; Regions can split as data grows and adjacent Regions can merge as data shrinks. This is topology precedent only.
